abstract: The Structural Maintenance of Chromosomes complex 5/6 (SMC-5/6) safeguards genome stability by coordinating DNA replication, repair, and chromosome organization. Although prior studies have advanced understanding of SMC-6, a domain-resolved view of its functions in vivo, particularly in multicellular organisms, remains incomplete.
